law: A codec is COMPUTED from sources (DESIGN-COMPUTED-CODEC.md): each source is one learned codec with its giver, scope and standing. This file is the SEED list of sources, not the choice: codecFor(material, context) selects and weights them at read time and returns the derivation. A context no source covers is the typed gap no_codec_source; no other language's or period's source is ever used and no English hub is assumed. Add a source only with its giver named and its data hash.

sources.varietyBasis: the treebank's own name: English Web Treebank
sources.periodBasis: not stated in priors/ud-codecs.json: unknown, never assumed
sources.standingBasis: learned from a corpus: a nomination, never given (the grain theorem); a named giver of the annotation convention would raise it to given

sources.varietyBasis: the treebank's own description: GUM, annotated texts from multiple text types (academic, conversation, fiction, interviews, news, reddit, speeches, vlogs and more)
sources.periodBasis: not stated in the registry: unknown, never assumed
sources.standingBasis: learned from a corpus: a nomination, never given (the grain theorem)

grammar.vendorCommand: download en_gum-ud-{train,dev,test}.conllu from github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_English-GUM into a directory UD_English-GUM, then: node native/scripts/train-ud-language.mjs --code=eng --dir=UD_English-GUM --ud=<dir> --out=~/.fold/ud-codecs/eng-gum (khora); NON-COMMERCIAL licence: vendored per machine, never committed
